name: mac-app-lifecycle-manager
description: Automated macOS application lifecycle management through scheduled closing and whitelist-based opening
author: Charles Brown Roberts

scripts.test:open-apps: bash -c "bash -n ./scripts/open-apps/open-apps.sh && [ -x ./scripts/open-apps/open-apps.sh ] && DRY_RUN=1 bash ./scripts/open-apps/open-apps.sh && echo 'open-apps dry-run OK'"
scripts.test:close-apps: bash -c "bash -n ./scripts/close-apps/close-apps.sh && [ -x ./scripts/close-apps/close-apps.sh ] && DRY_RUN=1 bash ./scripts/close-apps/close-apps.sh && echo 'close-apps dry-run OK'"
